correctness.rationale: At each induction stage Hensel plus CRT gives a unit prime residue class; Dirichlet supplies arbitrarily large new primes. The congruences force two independent 1 mod 4 prime-square divisors of every new cross sum. Jacobi yields r2>=36 for each cross sum; diagonals have r2=12. Only one unordered deleted-root pair represents a given candidate lost sum, by rapid growth, so a second representation necessarily survives. Proof covers all k and n.
